name: 12185-longdecode-qwen15moe27b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one vLLM engine.
architecture: Qwen2MoeForCausalLM, sparse MoE, 14.3B total parameters with ~2.7B active per token, GPTQ int4 (group_size 128, sym), ~8.4 GB of weights. The rest is in the checkpoint's own config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams = 1, warmup 25%, no cooldown, bounded at 24 requests with a 900 s safety cap.
workload: synthetic `synthetic_text`, single turn, `temperature: 0.0` (greedy), static seed 12185. Prompt EXACTLY 24 tokens and output EXACTLY 512 (min = max, zero dispersion); `ignore_eos` is forced, so every request generates exactly 512 tokens. The prompt is tokenized with add_special_tokens=True, so the engine may count and report a token or two more than 24.
purpose: A single-user creative writing assistant turning brief prompts into long 512-token passages, one request at a time, on one GPU.
launch:
# The served engine, as `vllm serve --config` takes it.
# 0.7.0-era AsyncEngineArgs: an unknown key is a TypeError at engine construction, so do not
# add keys from a later vLLM.
model: Qwen/Qwen1.5-MoE-A2.7B-Chat-GPTQ-Int4
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: float16
max-model-len: 2048
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
